INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE YOU CAN TRUST

Alcohol Beverage Law

Legal counsel from an attorney who doesn't just understand the industry, he built a business in it. Justin D. Leigh is the founder of Dwinell Country Ales, an award-winning farmhouse brewery in Washington.

From navigating federal licensing to resolving distributor disputes, Justin brings firsthand ownership experience to every alcohol beverage matter. When your attorney has walked the same path you're on, you get counsel you can actually trust.

Dwinell Country Ales

Award-Winning Farmhouse Brewery

Founded in 2017, Dwinell Country Ales became known for rustic saisons, barrel-aged mixed culture fruit beers, and spontaneous fermentation using their own coolship.

In 2023, the brewery expanded its offerings to include clean lagers, homegrown orchard hard cider, and locally sourced natural wine. The 3,000+ square foot facility included a tasting room, production space, and spacious patio.

This real-world experience building and operating a licensed beverage business from the ground up gives Justin a practical edge that most attorneys simply cannot offer.

The Advantage

When your attorney has personally navigated TTB approvals, distributor negotiations, state liquor board compliance, and taproom operations, you get counsel rooted in real experience, not just textbook knowledge.

How We Help

Beverage Industry Legal Services

Licensing & Compliance

Navigate the complex web of federal, state, and local licensing requirements for breweries, wineries, distilleries, and taprooms.

Distributor Contracts & Dispute Resolution

Draft, review, and negotiate distribution agreements. Resolve disputes with distributors to protect your brand and margins.

TTB COLA & Formula Approval

Streamline your Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau certificate of label approval and formula submissions.

FDA Compliance

Ensure your products, labeling, and facilities meet FDA requirements for food safety and ingredient disclosure.

Intellectual Property

Protect your brand names, logos, and recipes with trademark registration and trade secret strategy.

Enforcement Action Defense

Defend against regulatory actions, violations, and penalties from state liquor boards, the TTB, and other agencies.
